maddeler.e:
يلتهمون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَهِمُونَ (yaltahimūna) /jal.ta.hi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# يُلْتَهَمُونَ (yultahamūna) /jul.ta.ha.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
